Discuss probability, incident cooldown and disengagement before implementation; current Watched/higher responses and civilian protection stay as implemented for 3F.

subphases.task: Rival HQ camping: street-only hero or crew presence counts once per clan; nobody indoors counts. Boundary radius 12 world units, centered on each HQ main entrance/exit ring, separate from territory. Warn at 20 seconds, activate at 30 seconds within a rolling minute. Flash amber area boundary on warning; subtle red outline/pulse and small leave-area notice during penalty. Add a flat 12 heat and 12 lifetime infamy every 5 occupied seconds while active; this source alone bypasses the top-infamy heat multiplier so each charge stays exactly 12. Other heat/infamy sources retain their existing amounts and scaling. Leaving pauses further penalties, but clearing an activated alarm requires 30 uninterrupted seconds with the whole clan outside the zone. Any re-entry immediately resumes penalties and resets the entire 30-second decay. The alert shows a decay bar outside and stays full while inside; this replaces the superseded third-bounce/minute-expiry rule. Daytime routine police: 8 total (4 HQ, 2 each police box), walk out at dawn and return to their own station at dusk; finish active pursuit/arrests first. Respond to witnessed civilian assaults/executions and existing heat rules; existing heat-based reinforcements continue including at night. Police dots are blue on both maps, red when hostile to the viewing clan. Hero and crew require explicit attack orders against regular police patrols/reinforcements; they may automatically fight or retaliate against police defending unclaimed businesses in attack waves, because wave hits add no infamy. Business attacks still add 15 heat on completion or failure. No special AI camping avoidance for now; investigate only if playtests reveal problems. Pleasure Quarter now has two additional opposite openings in its existing NW and SE stone walls (x=6 and x=51, aligned around z=32), removing two wall segments on each side. Original entrance stays; no added paths, paving or Townhouse connection. Future ranged weapons require checking boundary coverage against their eventual firing range.
subphases.status: implemented; Node continuous-clear camping decay/street-only, patrol lifecycle/replacement, civilian response, existing police, AI, business/raid/indoor and settings checks passed; awaiting user visual playtest
